concerns.text: SC-005 requires test-retest reliability (ICC ≥ 0.7) on subjects with repeated scans. No task identifies repeated-scan subjects or computes test-retest ICC; T026–T028/T074 only compute ICC across window sizes (FR-011). SC-005 has no covering task.

SC-001 requires a measured ≥80% successful-preprocessing rate against total available subjects. T078 reports exclusion counts but no task computes or checks the SC-001 success-rate ratio with a pass/fail outcome.

T038b specifies final_results.csv columns 'subject_id, metric, genre, r, p_raw, p_adj, p_adj_bh', which do not cover the contract's required fields (metric_name, network_type, spearman_r, p_adjusted, is_significant, power_achieved, permutation_count). The task cannot produce a contract-conforming artifact as written.

The data model and data flow declare the results artifact as data/derived/correlations.csv; tasks write only data/derived/final_results.csv. The data-model element has no matching task output path, so an implementer following the data model produces an unverified file.

concerns.location: plan.md:Constitution Check Principle II vs tasks.md:all
concerns.text: The plan marks Principle II BLOCKING: 'cannot proceed until a verified source [for STOMP-R/musical preference] is identified or the spec is amended.' No task identifies/verifies a dataset containing the behavioral variable; T077–T081 assume real results exist. The blocking plan element is uncovered.

Constitution VI and the plan's Constitution Check mandate a version-controlled preprocessing manifest recording the fMRIPrep container version, CLI args, and config. T014 implements the Docker wrapper but no task creates or verifies the preprocessing manifest.

T077's thin run on 5 subjects conflicts with the N≥85 hard gate (T046/T038c exit code 1 on ERR_UNDERPOWERED): the quickstart end-to-end step cannot both halt and 'produce real result rows'. No task covers a pilot-mode bypass of the gate, leaving the quickstart element unexecutable as specified.
